scope: Bound role ledger refresh and invalidate the prior actionable snapshot while retaining confirmed transaction evidence
behavior: Manual refresh and post-transaction refresh have a three-minute continuation deadline and workspace lifetime check.
Starting a refresh clears the prior snapshot; failed/expired reads cannot leave transaction actions enabled from stale state.
Late reads cannot replace a successful explicit retry. Existing receipt and encrypted finalization journal remain available; no automatic transaction retry is added.

unit.scope: Complete RoleWorkspace suite, including a new manual timer expiry followed by successful retry and a late stale response, plus post-finality wall-clock expiry with retained/decryptable journal and only one SDK transaction.

release.scope: Normal web build/typecheck and release manifest.

limits: Ledger/SDK responses are mocked in component tests; existing backup encryption remains real. No new browser E2E or native-wallet ceremony.
Already-started SDK reads are not cancelled. Refresh does not independently authenticate ledger inclusion/finality.
No full regression, runtime-image refresh or public deployment. Other reads, including disclosure acceptance, are separate workflows.
